description: Create a new X-Matrix. Use this to start a strategy from scratch: create the matrix, then add elements with upsert_element and wire them with set_correlation. The first matrix of an organization becomes the default one. For a multi-level deployment (group → business unit → site), create the lower-level matrix with parent_matrix_id, then link each of its elements to what it deploys from above with upsert_element.parent_element_id.

is_default.description: Make this the default matrix of the organization

parent_matrix_id.description: UUID of the matrix of the level above (e.g. the group matrix for a business-unit matrix). At most 4 levels.

period_end.description: End of the period, ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)

period_start.description: Start of the period, ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)

period_type.description: Planning horizon (default: annual). A multi-year strategy is "custom" with period_start and period_end.

name: create_matrix
